text: Bring one small thing to mind. Something that has been nagging.
Now picture it from a few steps back, like you are watching someone else.
Take a moment. Look at the whole scene.
Now put it into words. Quietly describe what that person is dealing with.
Keep going. Name what matters most about it.
Now notice what you would tell them to do next.
Let that answer sit for a moment.
Seeing it and saying it worked better than either alone.
Come back to this when the next thing turns up.
